name: Witchcraft
description: Witchcraft writes the document on a scroll of speckled kraft paper, framed in a double line with flourishes, against a sky of stars and crescent moons, with carved capitals for headings, or deep plum and gold when the theme is dark.
tagline: for a purple grimoire under the moon

screenshots.alt: The deploy runbook in the Witchcraft look: a framed kraft-paper scroll against a sky of stars and crescent moons, with ship asking to run
The Witchcraft look with the dark theme: the scroll in deep plum, ruled in gold
Settings › Look with Witchcraft chosen: the stars and moons and the glow around cards can be turned off
